parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If the ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.

> If no ID value is displayed for the public instance, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).

parameters.name: JobId
parameters.description: The task ID. The globally unique identifier of the task.
